title: eBird Checklist Species Count Leaderboard
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebird:checklist species_count=*
| stats sum(species_count) as total_value, avg(species_count) as avg_value by location_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks location values by total and average species count across eBird checklist events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `species_count` values for each eBird checklist event and review total and average species count by location.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total species count.
grandmaExplanation: It catches which location shows the biggest species count numbers in your eBird checklist data.
